subject: How to import our therapist categories via CSV?
body:
Hi Support Team,
We have a spreadsheet containing around 350 practitioner sub-categories that we want to load into our new directory. Could you explain the exact steps to import categories using a CSV file? What columns are mandatory and where do I click in the admin menu?
Thanks,
Sarah

subject: Setting up email forwarders for attorneys
body:
Hello,
I need to set up email forwarding so that contact inquiries sent to partner@metrolegal.org automatically forward to their individual Gmail addresses. Is this supported directly inside Brilliant Directories, or do I have to use cPanel?
Best regards,
David Chen

subject: Social media links in header and footer
body:
Good morning,
Where in the dashboard can I configure our Instagram, LinkedIn, and Facebook company page links so they display across all directory pages?
Elena

subject: Question about sending a mass email campaign to 5,000 clinic members
body:
Hi there,
We want to send an announcement newsletter to all our 5,000 registered clinic profiles next Tuesday. Does Brilliant Directories have a native mass email campaign feature, and are there sending limits we should keep in mind?
Marcus

subject: Overriding default CSS stylesheets
body:
Hi Team,
Our designer provided custom CSS for hover states and button gradients. How do we override the default theme stylesheet without losing changes during future platform updates?
Rachel

subject: How to format zip codes in member CSV upload
body:
Hello,
Many of our contractor zip codes start with zero (e.g. 07030 in New Jersey), but Excel keeps stripping the zero to 7030. How should we format these zip code columns before uploading the CSV so the location geocoding doesn't fail?
Thanks,
Tom

subject: Setting up webmail accounts for staff
body:
Hi Support,
We hired two new directory moderators and want to create support@fitnesscoaches.com and info@fitnesscoaches.com. What are the steps to create these email accounts and access the webmail portal?
Regards,
Alicia

subject: Understanding 3-tier category hierarchy
body:
Hey team,
We are organizing auto repair services into Top Level, Sub Level, and Sub-Sub level. Does the platform support 3 tiers, and what column names in the CSV represent each tier?
Cheers,
Brian

subject: Can we host our WordPress recipes blog on Brilliant Directories directly?
body:
Hi,
We have an existing WordPress site with 200 baking recipes. Can we install and run WordPress directly on the same Brilliant Directories server hosting, or must it remain on a separate external subdomain?
Thanks,
Sophia

subject: How to assign tag groups to members upon CSV import
body:
Hello,
When importing 1,200 founders via CSV, can we assign an automated tag and tag group so we can segment them for future newsletters? Where is this option selected during the upload wizard?
Liam Patel

subject: Member profile photo bulk importing
body:
Hi Support,
We have image URLs for 400 photographer headshots. Can the CSV member importer automatically download and attach profile photos from full http image URLs?
Zoe

subject: Setting member listings to Active vs Not Active on import
body:
Hello,
Before launching publicly, we want to import our club database with status 'Not Active' until each club verifies their listing. Is there an option during CSV import to default all imported profiles to Not Active?
George Vance

subject: URGENT: Member CSV import fails on row 42 with blank columns
body:
Hi Support,
I've been trying to upload our agent roster for 3 hours and the import keeps throwing an error or skipping listings. Some of our rows have blank values for phone and fax columns. Does the system require blank columns to be deleted or filled with placeholders? Please help urgently as our marketing launch is tomorrow morning.
Kenneth

subject: Email forwarder not delivering inquiries to Yahoo addresses
body:
Hello,
We configured an email forwarder from contact@architectsforum.fr to two of our directors' Yahoo email addresses. Tests sent to the alias don't arrive in the inbox or spam folder. Could there be an SPF or DKIM issue with forwarders?
Valerie

subject: CSS override stylesheet not updating on live site after saving
body:
Hi Support,
I added custom styles in the Custom CSS tab under Design Settings. When I save, the dashboard says updated, but the live site continues to serve the old stylesheet even in private incognito mode. Is there a server-side cache that needs flushing?
Derek

subject: Geocoding fails for UK postcodes during member import
body:
Hello,
We are importing 600 UK clinicians with London postcodes (e.g. SW1A 1AA). The importer finishes, but on the search map their coordinates show 0,0 in the ocean! Does this require a Google Maps API Server Key in the advanced settings?
Thanks,
Hannah

subject: Category dropdown menu displaying blank options
body:
Hi,
We imported categories via CSV earlier today. The admin category manager shows 80 categories, but on the public search form the dropdown only shows empty blank lines! Did the top-level parent ID mapping get corrupted?
Gary

subject: Webmail login gives 'Login Failed' with correct password
body:
Support,
I created manager@quebecrestos.ca in the email accounts tool. I verified the password twice, but logging in through webmail gives an authentication error. Can you check if the mailbox was properly initialized?
Monique

subject: SSL Certificate error warning showing in Chrome
body:
Hi,
Visitors to our directory are reporting a red 'Your connection is not private' security warning on secure checkout pages. The SSL toggle in General Settings is turned ON. How do we resolve this certificate mismatch?
Jason

subject: Members selecting multiple categories not saving properly
body:
Hello Support,
Our members want to list under both 'Software Development' and 'Cloud Consulting'. When they edit their profile and tick both, only the primary category persists after saving. Is there a specific workaround setting for multi-category selection?
Priya

subject: Mass email newsletter stuck in queue
body:
Hi,
I scheduled a mass email to 1,800 guide operators at 9:00 AM. It has been 4 hours and the campaign status still says 'Sending (0 / 1800)'. Can someone restart the mail processing worker?
Carlos

subject: Social media preview card image not updating on Facebook share
body:
Hello,
We updated the Social Media share image in General Settings, but pasting our directory link into Facebook debugger still displays the old discontinued logo. How do we force the OpenGraph tags to clear?
Natalie

subject: Custom appointment booking module integration request
body:
Hi Consulting Team,
We want to hire your development team to build a custom calendar and appointment booking feature directly onto our doctor profile pages, syncing with Google Calendar. Can you handle custom engineering projects like this, and what is your process for scoping?
Sincerely,
Arthur Pendelton

subject: Project Proposal: Multi-vendor marketplace addon
body:
Hello,
We are looking to expand our pet carers directory into an e-commerce marketplace where dog walkers and sitters can sell physical pet accessories and receive direct payouts via Stripe Connect. Can we schedule a meeting this week to discuss architectural feasibility and project scope?
Samantha

subject: Custom API integration with HubSpot CRM
body:
Dear Dev Team,
Every time a new financial firm registers on our directory, we need an automated webhook / API sync that pushes their company record and tier into our HubSpot Enterprise pipeline. Would this be considered a custom project or does an out-of-the-box Zapier webhook exist?
Vikram

subject: Request to develop custom iOS and Android mobile apps for our directory
body:
Hi there,
Our board has approved budget to wrap our existing Brilliant Directories platform into native iOS and Android apps with push notifications for member direct messages. We need a dev partner to design and ship this over the next 2 months. Are you taking on new projects?
Clara

subject: Bespoke 3D virtual tour embed on venue listings
body:
Hello Team,
We want to commission custom development so venue managers can embed Matterport 3D virtual tours into a dedicated tab on their profiles. Can someone review this requirement and let us know what is involved?
Evelyn

subject: Arabic localization & RTL layout implementation project
body:
Greetings,
We are launching an engineering directory in the UAE and require full Right-to-Left (RTL) Arabic layout customization and bilingual interface toggling. We want to contract your team for the complete translation and layout overhaul.
Farooq

subject: Request for immediate cancellation and refund of annual renewal
body:
To Billing Support,
My account was charged $890 today for an annual renewal that I did not intend to renew. I have not used the directory for 4 months. Please cancel my subscription immediately and issue a full refund to my original credit card. Please confirm once the refund has been processed.
Robert Callahan

subject: Cancel account within 30-day trial and refund setup fee
body:
Hi,
We signed up on October 2nd under your 30-day satisfaction guarantee. The software does not meet our firm's compliance requirements. Please close our account and process the full refund of the $350 onboarding fee as agreed in your policy.
Megan Foster

subject: Duplicate charge on Visa card - please reverse immediately
body:
Hello Accounts,
I noticed two identical charges of $199 on my Visa statement yesterday. It looks like the checkout button was submitted twice during our plan upgrade. Please refund the duplicate transaction immediately.
Justin

subject: Downgrade plan and prorated refund inquiry
body:
Hi Billing,
We currently pay for the VIP Enterprise plan ($299/mo), but our volunteer team only needs the Basic plan ($79/mo). Can you downgrade our subscription for next month and apply any prorated credit to our balance?
Beatrice

subject: Notice of Contract Termination and Request for Refund
body:
To Whom It May Concern,
Pursuant to Section 8 of our Service Level Agreement, we hereby give notice of termination due to ongoing service interruptions. We request a full refund of the unused retainer balance ($1,450) remitted via wire transfer.
Harvey Specter, Partner

subject: Cancelling addon booster pack
body:
Hi Support,
We no longer need the Extra Storage booster pack that costs $25/month. Please remove it from our active add-ons before our next billing cycle on Nov 1st.
Chloe

subject: UNACCEPTABLE: Site down during our national advertising broadcast!
body:
I am writing this email extremely furious. Our directory went completely offline during our televised non-profit drive tonight. We lost thousands of potential registrations. What is your uptime SLA and why was our database unreachable for 45 minutes?! I expect an immediate call from a senior executive.
Danielle Ross, CEO

subject: Third update in a row that broke our custom member forms
body:
Your latest platform patch wiped out the custom select fields we configured in Member Categories last month. This is the third time an unannounced update has reverted our customizations. Your team needs to fix regression testing before rolling out updates to production.
Dr. House

subject: Terrible customer service delay on ticket #8941
body:
I submitted a high-priority ticket on Thursday regarding credit card processor failures on our live site. It has been 4 days and no human has replied, only canned automated responses. Our members cannot pay us! If this is not resolved today we are moving our directory to a competitor.
Karen

subject: Incorrect billing amount charged on invoice #INV-4921
body:
Hello,
Our agreed contract price was $150 per month, but our credit card was charged $220 without explanation. Please adjust invoice #INV-4921 and fix your automated billing system to reflect our signed agreement.
Timothy

subject: Data export feature constantly timing out
body:
Your member export tool has been timing out with a 504 Gateway Error whenever we attempt to export our 12,000 talent records. We need our own data for audit purposes and your system is preventing us from accessing it. This needs to be escalated to engineering immediately.
Olga

subject: Slow page loading speeds ruining user experience
body:
Page load times on our search directory have degraded to over 8 seconds. Our Google Core Web Vitals score dropped to 32. We pay for your managed plan and expect server performance to support our traffic.
Stanley

subject: Quote inquiry: Migrating 25,000 solar installers from WordPress
body:
Hello Consulting Team,
We are planning to migrate our database of 25,000 solar contractors from a custom WordPress/WooCommerce site to Brilliant Directories. Could you provide a formal quote and timeline estimate for data cleaning, category mapping, and full import?
Best regards,
Rebecca Thorne

subject: Price estimate for bespoke homepage redesign
body:
Hi there,
We would like a quote to revamp our homepage with custom hero video background, animated category search pills, and a featured members slider. How much would this customization cost and what is your current turnaround time?
Nathan

subject: Quote for custom payment gateway integration (Razorpay)
body:
Dear Sales,
We operate primarily in South Asia and require Razorpay and UPI payment gateways integrated into our membership checkout rather than Stripe/PayPal. Can you provide a scope and quote for custom gateway development?
Ananya Joshi

subject: Cost estimate for building 4 custom landing page templates
body:
Hello,
We need 4 dedicated landing page templates designed to convert band managers, audio engineers, session musicians, and studios. Could you estimate developer hours and provide a quote for this design pack?
Keith

subject: Consulting quote for SEO audit and schema markup optimization
body:
Hi Tech Team,
We want a quote for an AI Tech Consultant to review our directory's local schema markup, sitemap configuration, and breadcrumb structure to boost our Google Local pack rankings. What would a full audit cost?
Fiona

subject: Follow-up: Meeting notes on marketplace addon discussion
body:
Hi Consulting Team,
Following up on our call yesterday regarding the pet marketplace add-on. Did your lead engineer have a chance to check if the Brilliant Directories core allows split payouts via Stripe, or will we need a custom webhook?
Thanks,
Samantha

subject: Following up on quote for calendar booking integration
body:
Hello,
I sent a project inquiry last Thursday about integrating Google Calendar booking onto doctor profiles. Just wanted to check if you received my email and when we can expect a formal scope of work?
Arthur

subject: Checking in: status of ticket #5092 (Member CSV upload)
body:
Hi Support,
Just following up on my urgent ticket from earlier regarding the blank columns error during our agent CSV import. Is there an update from the database team?
Kenneth

subject: Follow-up on data migration feasibility questions
body:
Hello Rebecca here,
Checking in on the 25k member migration proposal. We prepared the sample CSV export file you requested. Who on your technical team should I send the secure download link to?
Best,
Rebecca

subject: Awaiting executive incident report regarding last night's downtime
body:
Hello,
I am following up on my previous message. It has now been 4 hours since the service outage. We require a formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and confirmation of credits applied to our enterprise account.
Danielle Ross
